_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Product Family Prime Vendor Support Status Report
summary: Defines the format and content for reporting current material or service status of active and completed Delivery Orders and Requests for Proposals to the Product Families.
use_relationship:
The Product Family Prime Vendor Support Status Report provides current material or service statuses to the Product Families (PFs) for all active and completed Delivery Orders (DOs), as well as active and completed Requests for Proposals (RFPs) associated with the contract. The Prime Vendor support status data will be for contractor weekly reports, contracting officer's representative (COR) record keeping, data base updates, and funding requests.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in the contractor's format. The Report shall be in a format similar to that of Sample Figure 1 with separate worksheets for active DOs, active RFPs, completed DOs and completed RFPs for the current and each contract year (separate worksheet for each year).

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall contain the following information:

children.title: DO number # (sorted by numerical ascending order)
Vendor name and Point of Contact
Associated PF and requesting General Supply Specialist (GSS) or POC
Required delivery date (RDD)
children.content: (with all RDDs due in the next week highlighted in yellow)

children.title: Status
children.content: On-schedule (highlighted in green), or Late (highlighted in red)

children.title: Pertinent comments
children.content: i.e. status of Delivery Orders. Ensure all documentation is processed to complete Delivery Orders. Report issues with Delivery orders so problems can be resolved.

children.title: Shipping tracking information
children.content: The Contractor will give updated status of location and delivery date for material requested and any issues where delivery maybe delayed or not completed.

children.title: RDD extension (Ext) requested (yes or no)
children.content: date of request, date of new proposed RDD, and whether delays were caused by the Government or the Contractor.

children.title: RDD extension contract modification issued (yes or no) issued and date
Consideration of RFP and or Delivery order issues requested or granted
Associated PF and requesting GSS or POC Noemi Valdez
Description of material and or service
Status of vendor quotes
children.content: which vendors are bidding with their price for material. Requesting status of how much of the material is onboard, when it can be delivered and is it technically correct for use with the equipment we are installing it in.

children.title: Status
children.content: On-schedule (highlighted in green), or Late (highlighted in red)

children.title: Pertinent comments
